name: 10 South Van Ness
aliases: 10 South Van Ness Avenue Mixed-Use Project
acresNote: The project's CEQA filings (State Clearinghouse 2017072018): a 1.17-acre triangular site, Assessor's Block 3506, Lots 003A and 004, bounded by Market Street, South Van Ness Avenue and 12th Street.

program.notes: As described in SF Planning's record of the approved application (2024-008986PRJ): a 67-story residential building with 921 homes, 2,360 sq ft of ground-floor retail, 38,282 sq ft of common open space on several roof decks, and a two-level, 31,561 sq ft basement garage with 105 parking spaces, two loading spaces and 352 bicycle spaces. The same record's unit-count fields list 1,019 homes, 89 of them affordable. The application was filed under Government Code Section 65913.4 (SB 423), the state's streamlined, ministerial review, using the State Density Bonus Law. The tower's approved height is not yet confirmed by an official document. It replaces a two-story 1927 building last used as the San Francisco Honda dealership.

publicPartners: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
stageNote: SF Planning's record of the streamlined application shows an approval letter issued, and the record was closed on Aug 18, 2026. The Department of Building Inspection received an application to demolish the existing two-story building on Sept 4, 2026; no permit for the new tower has been issued.

timeline.event: SF Planning opens case 2015-004568 for a high-rise residential project at 10 South Van Ness Avenue.
Planning issues the notice of preparation of an EIR, studying two 41-story, 400-ft towers and a single 55-story, 590-ft tower as a variant.
Planning Commission certifies the project's Final EIR (Motion 20720) for a 55-story, 590-ft tower with up to 966 homes.
Planning Commission adopts CEQA findings (Motion 20741) and shadow findings (Motion 20742) and approves the 55-story, 590-ft tower with 966 homes (Motions 20743 and 20744).
A site permit application for the 55-story, 966-home building is filed with DBI (application 202206176565); it has not been issued.
Planning Commission hears a modified 55-story, 590-ft design with 1,012 homes; Planning's record shows the modification approved, with a new deadline of March 15, 2026 to obtain a site permit.
Planning Commission agenda lists an informational presentation on a new 65-story, 952-home design under the state's streamlined review (SB 423); the notice of intent was filed on Oct 2, 2024.
SF Planning opens the streamlined application (2024-008986PRJ).
Planning closes the application's record with an approval letter issued: a 67-story building with 921 homes.
An application to demolish the existing two-story commercial building is filed with DBI (application 202609047753).

nextMilestone: Demolition and a site permit for the tower: DBI has a demolition application (filed Sept 4, 2026) and no site permit application for the 67-story design on record.
summary: A 67-story residential tower approved for the triangular block at Market Street, South Van Ness Avenue and 12th Street, the former San Francisco Honda dealership: 921 homes over ground-floor retail. SF Planning approved it under the state's streamlined, ministerial review (SB 423), after the Planning Commission had approved a 55-story, 590-ft tower for the site in 2020. Its height is not yet confirmed by an official document.

reported.program.notes: An 820-ft, 67-story tower with 1,019 homes as first approved; the September 2026 revision cut it to 921 homes at the same height.

timeline.event: SF Planning approves a 67-story, about 820-ft tower with 1,019 homes, which would be the city's third-tallest building.
A revised approval cuts the homes to 921 at the same height and extends the entitlement to August 2029.
